in_hindi.name: अरविन्द
in_hindi.meaning: Lotus with a thousand petals or the protector of the universe
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरविन्द (Aravind) is derived from the word 'Aravinda' which means 'lotus with a thousand petals'. It can also mean 'one who is the protector of the universe'. In Hinduism, Lord Vishnu is often depicted on a lotus flower and is considered the protector of the universe.

in_tamil.name: அரவிந்த
in_tamil.meaning: Lotus with a thousand petals or the protector of the universe
in_tamil.long_meaning: Arabinda is derived from the Tamil word 'Aravindam' which is a compound of 'Aravam' (lotus) and 'Indam' (thousand). It can also mean 'one who is the protector of the universe'. In Hinduism, Lord Vishnu is often depicted on a lotus flower and is considered the protector of the universe.

in_telugu.name: అరవింద
in_telugu.meaning: Beginning of the goddess of the moon
in_telugu.long_meaning: Arabinda is derived from 'Arabh' meaning 'beginning' and 'Indu' meaning 'goddess of the moon'. It could mean 'the beginning of the goddess of the moon'.
